kid.description: Which configured verify secret matched, or dual-accept for a legacy bare key

key_epoch.description: The KEY epoch from field 2 of the stream key. Not the session epoch and not the fencing epoch (API.md 8.3).

dual_accept.description: true means this producer is still on a legacy bare key and needs re-keying. This field is the re-keying workflow's data source: the window closes when it stops appearing, not on a date.

delivery.description: The delivery ULID. Matches X-Tmesis-Delivery. Duplicated in the body so a receiver that logs bodies has the dedupe key without the headers.

occurred_at.description: RFC3339 UTC, when the event happened on the node. ORDER BY THIS, never by arrival: delivery is unordered.

session.description: Session ULID. Correlates with stream.unpublished and the per-feed timeline.

epoch.description: The SESSION epoch: local publish generation for this stream. Not the key epoch.

remote.description: Publisher address and port. Present for operators; it is not an authorization input.

role.description: From the structured stream id. Stream roles are attributes, never name suffixes.

labels.description: Echoes the labels set on the stream. The node never interprets them.
